title: Slovakian Plum Compote
description: A traditional Slovakian dessert made with fresh plums and a touch of sweetness.
instructions: Combine sliced plums, Slovakian dried plums puree, and brine in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the plums are tender.
Stir in compote syrup and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Strain the compote through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl.
Discard the solids and refrigerate the compote for at least 2 hours.
Serve chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon if desired.
